limitations: Motor PCB is byte-identical; remapped GPIO pad nets intentionally await a separate update.
MaixCAM2 ~1A typical limit versus inference/charging peaks is unmeasured; independent reverse blocking and UART isolation absent after approved simplification.
12V 12.5A source estimate ~11.09A at85% efficiency, with assumed4A wheels and3A stepper, leaves limited margin; load/startup/thermal tests required.
Stepper VM and UART are direct; current simplified circuit has no independent MCU power-off.
Core external3.3V load budget<=100mA and encoder3.3V operation need hardware confirmation.
XT60 exact model, generic-model dimensions, connector mating and button lead geometry remain unverified.
